_readme: Every case is the base document plus one patch, so the defect under test is
the only difference from a clean draft. Fictional throughout: the ground
truth in this directory describes a person who does not exist.
A patch path is dotted, with integers indexing lists.
expect.keywords: the report counts as a detection if it contains any one of
them (case-insensitive). expect.min_severity: the lowest severity that
counts. clean:true cases must draw no CRITICAL and no MEDIUM finding.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager
bullets: Owned the carrier-integration platform used by 340 freight partners.
Cut average dispatch confirmation time from 14 minutes to 9 minutes across the partner network.
Shipped a self-serve onboarding flow that moved 61% of new partners off manual setup.
Ran a controlled pilot of automated exception handling with 12 partners; Phase 1, still in beta.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Launched a zero-to-one shipment-tracking mobile app that reached 90,000 monthly active users in its first year.
Reduced support ticket volume 18% by rewriting the delivery-status notification copy.
Coordinated a three-team migration off a deprecated pricing service.

cover_letter.recipient:
Meridian Freight Hiring Team
Meridian Freight
Portland, OR
cover_letter.salutation: To the Meridian Freight Hiring Team,
paragraphs: Your posting for a Senior Product Manager on the carrier platform caught my attention because the integration problem you describe is the one I have spent the last three years inside at Northwind Logistics.

The work there is unglamorous and it touches real money. Carrier integration serves 340 freight partners, and the piece I would point at is the self-serve onboarding flow, which moved 61% of new partners off manual setup. The automated exception handling is in a controlled pilot with twelve partners. It is Phase 1 and still in beta, so there is not much to point at yet.

Before Northwind, a shipment-tracking app at Cascade Freight was the first thing I owned end to end. We thought people wanted a map. They wanted one sentence telling them whether the thing was late, and rewriting that copy cut support tickets 18%.
Happy to talk if you are open to a short conversation.
